11041|96c601a6.name: Milla Fairancora
11041|96c601a6.text: Elune-adore, my sister. You are welcome here. Speak, and I will do what I can to aid you.

11042|04b4acc4.name: Sylvanna Forestmoon
11042|04b4acc4.text: Even slight alterations to a potion's ingredients can change it fundamentally. Patience and precision, young one: they will serve you well in all walks of life.

11050|402e026a.name: Trianna
11050|402e026a.text: My education is ongoing, and your knowledge surpasses mine. If you wish to learn more you must speak to Me'lynn. She will guide you.

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

14725|372d0086.name: Raedon Duskstriker
14725|372d0086.text:
Hail friend - a moment of your time, if I may...

We have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing Teldrassil.  Were the constant strife of the times not enough, we now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of night elves everywhere in helping us out!

15127|e2791228.name: Samuel Hawke
15127|e2791228.text: I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

258785|726390d0.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|726390d0.text: Surrender to the Light, $N. How can I help you serve today?

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4159|ea239844.name: Me'lynn
4159|ea239844.text: Your talents excel! You are truly inspired. To continue your pursuit of knowledge, speak with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. He is held in high regard, and will be able to further your instruction.

4160|126c2b9a.name: Ainethil
4160|126c2b9a.text: This potion seems to heal less damage every time I brew it, though I use the same ingredients. There can be only one conclusion: the plants are changing. I cannot say why or into what.

5171|86b6c1ef.name: Thistleheart
5171|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6382|721fd095.name: Jubahl Corpseseeker
6382|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

9099|738476a6.name: Sraaz
9099|738476a6.text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.

92415-accept.name: Unknown
92415-accept.text: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

95189-accept.name: Unknown
95189-accept.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189-accept.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust a filthy lesser breed like you. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: You're still alive? Hmmph. Well, what is it? Have you found my lord yet?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures
